data.name: Coloniam
data.detailed_description:
Coloniam - One World. Four Powers. Endless War.

Coloniam is a persistent real-time MMO grand strategy set on the actual map of Earth. While turn-based games pause and wait, Coloniam never sleeps. While you sleep — your enemy plans.

This is not a fresh launch. Coloniam has been running for over a decade as a browser MMO, and now arrives on Steam as a native desktop client.

Choose Your Power

Four real-world superpowers fight for dominance. Each has its own units, weapons, and strategic identity:

  • Russia — Industrial scale, ironclad strategy. Su-35 fighters, Kirov-class battleships, Yasen-class submarines, Kuznetsov carrier.

  • United States — Technological supremacy and naval power. F/A-18 Super Hornets, USS Iowa, USS Virginia subs, Gerald R. Ford carriers.

  • Europe — Diplomacy, finance, precision. Eurofighter Typhoon, HMS Dragon destroyers, HMS Astute submarines, Queen Elizabeth carrier.

  • Indo-China — Numbers, speed, industrial might. J-20 stealth fighters, Renhai cruisers, Type 093 submarines, Liaoning carrier.

Pick a side. Fight for it. Or betray it from within.

Real-World Map. Real-Time Stakes.

Coloniam plays out across the actual surface of Earth. Naval battles use accurate Web Mercator projection, wherever there is water on the planet, war can be fought there. Land armies march across continents in real time. Trade convoys cross oceans, factories run day and night, and battles rage 24/7. When you log off, your alliance defends the border. When you log back in, the world has moved.

What You Will Do

  • Build Your Empire — Found cities, raise walls, develop industry, become unstoppable.

  • Command Your Forces — Move armies across continents, lay siege to enemies, capture territory.

  • Naval Dominance — Direct aircraft carriers, submarines, cruisers, fighters, and bombers in real-time naval combat.

  • Master the Economy — Control trade routes, play the markets, dominate raw materials. Whoever rules the gold rules the war.

  • Diplomacy and Treason — Forge alliances, break treaties, run propaganda campaigns. Every move rewrites history.

  • Live in a Persistent World — Servers run 24/7. Your decisions have permanent consequences, even while you sleep.

Steam Native Client

  • Optimized Performance — Less memory and CPU than a browser tab.

  • In-Game Politics — Vote for global leaders, run for office, shape alliance policy.

A Decade of History

Coloniam has run for over ten years. Alliances have risen and fallen. Betrayals are still talked about. Players who started in their teens now command empires built across years of patient play. This is not a game with an ending — this is a world that continues.

For New Commanders

  • Read the in-game tutorial — it covers everything from your first city to your first battle.

  • Join an alliance early — solo players rarely survive their first month.

  • Ask questions — the community is over a decade old and welcomes newcomers.

  • Take it slow. Coloniam rewards patience over panic.

Coloniam — Real world. Real war. One life. One power. Thousands of stories.

data.short_description: Real-time grand strategy MMO on the actual map of Earth. Choose one of four superpowers, command armies and navies, forge alliances, betray friends, and fight thousands of players in a persistent world that never pauses.
data.supported_languages: English, Croatian, Serbian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Greek, Romanian, Russian

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (build 1809+)
  • Processor: 2 GHz dual-core (Intel Core i3-3220 / AMD FX-4300)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4000
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 10.15 Catalina
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS / Debian 11 / Fedora 35
  • Processor: 2 GHz dual-core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Mesa 21+
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
